rationale: The Garage Door sensor (SEN-D1) was on firmware 1.0 speaking the legacy v2 radio protocol, while the HB-200 base station (fw 4.5) only supports v3, producing the E-305 fault and a "connected but no events" state. The standard L1 fix — an OTA upgrade to 1.3 — completed successfully and events resumed, confirming the root cause.

If events are working, close the case as resolved.

results.text: The peripheral firmware speaks a radio protocol the base station no longer supports, or vice versa. Frontline action: trigger OTA upgrade of the peripheral. If OTA is not available for the device or fails twice, escalate to FAE as protocol conflict.

Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

Base station firmware updates are pushed automatically at night. HB-200 firmware 4.5 removes support for the legacy v2 radio protocol. Peripherals still running v2 firmware must be upgraded to v3 firmware before or after the base station update, otherwise they disconnect.
